request.description:
``GET /api/import-costs/estimate``: the flat query-string form of the
``deals_estimate_import_costs`` tool input (``DealsEstimateImportCostsInput``), which it is
converted to before use, so both surfaces apply the same rules.

``listing_id`` and/or vehicle facts. Every vehicle parameter that is GIVEN replaces the
listing's fact; an omitted one keeps the listing's (or stays unknown, never zero). The nested
tool objects are flattened: ``price_amount`` + ``price_currency``; one ``co2_<cycle>_g_km`` per
measurement cycle, exactly as printed on the document (never converted); ``origin_proof_kind``
with ``origin_proof_country`` / ``origin_proof_evidence_ref``. ``co2_clear=true`` estimates
without any CO2 figure (the listing's claim is dropped) and takes no ``co2_*_g_km``. Failures
name these flat parameters.
request.title: ImportCostEstimateQuery

price.description:
A money amount for display. Unknown is ``amount: null`` with ``status: unknown``, never 0.

``amount`` is rounded half-up to the currency's minor unit; the exact arithmetic happened
on the backend before rounding (spec 3, 18).

rule.description:
The rule set behind the figures. ``content_sha256`` is the recorded hash or, for an
unsealed draft, the hash computed from its content (``sha256_recorded`` false).
rule.title: ImportRuleView

items.description:
One labelled scenario (``legal_base`` first). In ``active`` mode the totals are ``total``,
``total_eur`` and ``landed_cost_eur`` (the ``indicative_*`` fields are null); in a preview
the reverse. A total is known only when the calculation is complete; otherwise it is
unknown and ``known_subtotal`` (labelled, never a total) shows what resolved.
One import category in the rule currency, and in EUR at the customs rate.
